falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 3.0% above its lowest close of the prior 10 sessions on 5 or more of the next 14 sessions, while VIX closes below 16 on the same days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug analog confirmed as a completed low and a risk-on phase; HOLD/UNKNOWN was the wrong call because a long signal was already justified

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 prints a closing low more than 4.0% below its lowest close of the prior 20 sessions, or ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by 50 bps or more from today's level
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% bottom_2024_aug match failed; price action is a breakdown, not a base, so UNKNOWN/HOLD concealed a clear risk-off verdict

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 30 on any session in the next 14 days, or the US 10-year yield moves 40 bps or more in either direction from today's close
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A named volatility or rates regime shift resolved the unknown phase; staying at HOLD with a blowoff score of 39 would be falsified by an observable stress or reflation break

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
